questions.question:

Navigating through the dense forest, the hikers encountered _______ terrain, making the trek more challenging and adventurous.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

__
 
• The word **"treacherous"** means something that is hazardous because of presenting hidden or unpredictable dangers. (धोखेबाज, खतरनाक)

 
 
• **Example: **The icy roads were** treacherous**, causing several accidents.
 
 
 
• **"Treacherous"** terrain refers to land that is difficult to traverse due to hidden dangers or unpredictable conditions. (धोखेबाज भूभाग)
 
 
• **Example: **The climbers faced** treacherous** terrain as they made their way up the mountain.

• **Monotonous **(निरस): Lacking in variety and interest; repetitive and dull.
 
 
• **Example: **His** monotonous** routine made him yearn for some excitement.
 
 
 
• **Tranquil** (शांत): Free from disturbance; calm.
 
 
• **Example:** The** tranquil** lake provided a perfect setting for meditation.
